chunks: He turns night into day, and turns day into night; and He knows whatsoever is in your hearts.

key_terms.يُولِجُ: He causes to enter / He mixes one thing into another

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah turns night into day and day into night?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hadid underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty over the cosmic cycle of night and day, serving as a sign for those who reflect. It pairs this external manifestation of power with the internal attribute of 'Alim bi-dhati al-sudur' (Knower of the essence of the chests), highlighting that while humans observe His control over time, He alone perceives the hidden realities and intentions within the human heart.
